Kimia Na Motema · Montréal, since 2014

Stitching hope back together, one stitch at a time.

We are a Christian association serving orphans, widows, people in need and the homeless, free of charge. Meals, clothes, school, a helping hand: each act is a stitch that binds one life to another.

Give nowVolunteer with us

Lingala

“Kimia na motema”

In Lingala it means “peace of the heart”. That is what we hope to gently bring into every life we meet.

Everything is free

We ask nothing in return from the people we help.

No distinctions

Whatever their language, colour or origin, everyone is welcome.

Dignity first

No child's face without consent, no exact location ever published.

Missions

Four ways we care

Our four areas of aid, designed around the real needs of families.

Food aid

Meals and groceries so no one goes to bed hungry.

Clothing aid

Warm, dignified clothing, especially when the Québec winter arrives.

Academic support

Notebooks, homework help and workshops to move forward.

Material or financial help

Practical help when a family goes through a trial.
